parole.testo: From Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (ʾplnc /⁠āranǰ⁠⁠/), borrowed from Sogdian 𐫀𐫀𐫡𐫀𐫏𐫗𐫝 (ʾʾrʾync /⁠ārinǰ⁠⁠/), ultimately from Proto-Indo-Iranian *Haratníš. Compare Sanskrit अरत्नि (aratni).

parole.significato: to shine; to luster; to sheen; to coruscate; to glister; to glint
parole.testo: Akin to Central Kurdish درەوشان (drewşan, “to glitter”).
